newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia port Luka to list more shares.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia port Luka to list more shares.

text.p: Slovenian port company Luka Koper will list another 1,428,148 shares on the main market of the Ljubljana bourse on January 27, the Ljubljana Stock Exchange said on Monday.
The new shares will take the number of Luka's listed shares to 6.1 million, which together represent 43.6 percent of its capital. The shares have a nominal value of 1,000 tolars.

Luka, the country's only port, last month said its 1996 pre-tax profit was expected to rise to 1.5 billion tolars ($10.3 million) from 1.0 billion in 1995, but added it was likely to cut its dividend to some 100 tolars from 202.5 tolars in 1995.
The company said the dividend would be cut because the previous year's dividend had been paid from profits accumulated over the past three years.
Luka, which debuted on the market in November 1996, is 51 percent owned by the state, which has so far prevented foreign investors from taking a stake in the company.
